blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, ZAMBOANGA DEL SUR, Philippines — A Basilan province judge was shot and killed in Zamboanga City on Thursday morning. The killing drew widespread condemnation from lawyers and provincial officials, with the Supreme Court among those mourning and demanding justice for the judge’s death.
